Definition: Achab, the name of a king of Israel and of a prophet at Babylon
BiblicalUsage: Ahab = "father's brother"; 1) king of Israel, son of Omri, husband of Jezebel; 2) false prophet executed by Nebuchadrezzar, time of Jeremiah
